title: Reading Drill — Reusing labels in an archive — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Reusing labels in an archive — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The archive technician in Hillswick received an old report about sticky residue obscuring folder numbers. The report compared the number of damaged labels, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the inspection reports rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the age of the adhesive. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed card holders on each folder as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
